$comment: Versioning: x-schemaVersion follows semver. Breaking change = major bump. Conventions: durationSamples is sample count at the encoded artifact rate (not ms); for awf_v1_riff_mono_u8_peak that rate is points per second, not source-media sample rate. All URL values are server-relative URI references.
$comment-version: 1.1.1: clarify current standalone-companion RIFF amplitude identity and host-neutral path examples; 1.1.0 added path and optional url.
title: WaveformRef

itemId.description: Jellyfin item ID this waveform belongs to.

variant.description: Opaque artifact-format identity. The standalone companion emits awf_v1_riff_mono_u8_peak; awf_v1_native_mono_b8 names the historical audiowaveform DAT producer and is not byte-compatible with it.

pps.description: Points per second in the waveform data.

path.description: Store-relative path to the waveform .dat file, e.g. waveforms/{subjectStoreKey}/{variant}/pps_10.dat. Analyzer storage uses host-neutral subject identity; the gateway projects provider item identity only into the client-facing request URL.

url.description: Server-relative API URL. Absent in analyzer-written sidecars; populated by the gateway when serving TrackEvent responses.

etag.description: HTTP ETag for cache validation, including surrounding quotes.

durationSamples.description: Total sample count in the waveform at the encoded sample rate (not ms).
